    Proportional values of parallel paths #

    For a zero-detecting lift of the arrows of the ray category of a split basic distributive algebra, if every non-interlaced pair of paths with the same nonzero value is deep, then any two paths with the same nonzero value have proportional values (scalar_of_related_of_deep). The induction is on the depth of the common value: an interlacing step replaces an inner pair whose value has strictly smaller depth (BGRS 2.9).
